stops.note: a tall cap of the steppe peoples; the Karakalpaks, 'black hats', are named after it
the fur kalpak worn by Mustafa Kemal and his fighters in 1919–22 became a symbol of the Turkish War of Independence
spelled 'calpac' by early 19th-century travellers in the Levant and the Caucasus

current_meaning: a tall felt or fur cap worn in Turkey and Central Asia
